bootstrap.interval: 95% exploratory conditional on fixed checkpoints; no selection/multiplicity/training-seed correction

retention.quality_candidate: positive macroAUC point difference versus corresponding original with all tasks/costs reported
retention.scope: Queue policy, not statistical equivalence or automatic model promotion

conditional_best_single_comparisons.selection: For each parent, highest macroAUC successful candidate (tie fixed experiment order), only if point macroAUC exceeds best single; at most2 pairs.
conditional_best_single_comparisons.bootstrap: same accepted500user draws/seed20260906; selection-conditional exploratory intervals, not multiplicity or training-seed guarantee.

repair_policy: No optimizer/Q initialization/dense clipping or LR repair. Failed candidate stops and preserves artifacts; no automatic restart. No extra training seed.
hypothesis: First-work slots can exchange their retrieved contents before the second history lookup, without routing prediction state back into working state.

formula.native: x=(e+z1)/2 remains the original arithmetic and original outer work input.
formula.retrieval_only: second work w_q receives r=post_self_norm(x+post_self_attn_mode(x,z1,z1)); native w_qi and outer residual still receive x.

modes.all: Original learned attention over all work slots.
modes.own: Same projection/normalization/SDPA tensor shapes with diagonal boolean attention mask.
modes.uniform: Same projected Q/K/V and SDPA shapes; multiply projected normalized Q by exactly zero to obtain uniform all-slot weights.
modes.other: Same learned attention with diagonal excluded; q4/q8 ensure at least one allowed slot.

formula.weights: Reuse existing final post_self_attn projections/QK norms and post_self_norm. No new parameters, registered buffers or constructor random draws. Final native post attention/norm/FFN remains unchanged.
formula.route: Only second w_q input is replaced. First entry/work/read and prediction update, full history/K/V/mask, native two cycles and no prediction feedback are preserved.
formula.gradient_scope: Do not detach z1 or relay. Parameter layout equality does not preserve gradients, PSGDKron trajectory or kernel runtime; own/uniform QK gradients from the extra attention can be exactly zero.
formula.controls: Identity bypass must execute the original forward without relay arithmetic. Final post module remains native. No gradient checkpointing or model torch.compile because scoped forward hooks are not certified for recomputation.
formula.cost: One extra small-slot attention/projection and shared LayerNorm; parameter count unchanged but real training/forward latency and VRAM must be reported for every arm.

selection_boundary: Cross-slot versus own isolates access to other work contents within this trained family, not causal information quantity. All-versus-uniform tests adaptive slot mixing; other-versus-all tests own-slot inclusion. A candidate-to-candidate gain alone does not establish gain over the original. All tasks/direct contrasts reported without changing macro success metric.
